text: Ban Faqiran Stupa Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Ban Faqiran Stupa Type: Archaeological Site - Stupa & Monastery Province: Islamabad District: Islamabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1st - 5th Century CE Description: An archaeological site comprised of a stupa measuring 8.3m x 8.3m, square in plan. It is constructed in diaper masonry with mouldings in kanjur stone and covered with lime plaster, traces of which are still visible on the walls. Upper structure of the stupa is missing. There is a deep cut in the center of the stupa.
